title: XUrbanAI registry
description: Single source of truth for XUrbanAI entries. scripts/build.py generates the field lists on the site and the issue forms from this file; scripts/validate.py checks data/registry.json against it.

artifacts.title: Artifacts & citation
artifacts.description: Code, configurations, weights or task files, a version, a licence, and how to cite the entry.

x-registries.label: Models
x-registries.artifacts: Code, configuration, weights or access route, version, licence, and citation.

x-registries.label: Agents
x-registries.artifacts: Code, prompts or policies, configuration, version, licence, and citation.

x-registries.label: Benchmarks
x-registries.artifacts: Task files, evaluation code, version, licence, and citation.

id.description: Stable identifier, used in the entry URL.

summary.description: One sentence shown in the registry list.

url.description: Optional external card. When absent the entry is rendered by entry.html.

urban_question.title: Urban question
urban_question.description: The city problem the work addresses, and who is meant to use the result.

data_provenance.title: Data provenance
data_provenance.description: Sources, geography, time span, licence, and processing steps for every dataset used.

evaluation.title: Evaluation
evaluation.description: Tasks, metrics, baselines, and protocol, with results reported as released.

failure_modes.title: Failure modes
failure_modes.description: Known limitations, observed errors, and conditions under which the result should not be trusted.

geographic_validity.title: Geographic validity
geographic_validity.description: Cities tested, and whether claims are local or supported by cross-city evidence.

usage_constraints.title: Usage constraints
usage_constraints.description: Intended users, prohibited uses, and requirements for human review.

intended_task.title: Intended task
intended_task.description: The prediction, representation, or generation task, and the urban decision it is meant to inform.

inputs_modalities.title: Inputs & modalities
inputs_modalities.description: Imagery, maps, mobility traces, text, tabular records, or sensor streams, with resolution and preprocessing.

data_provenance.title: Training data
data_provenance.description: Sources, geography, time span, licence, sampling, and any data that was excluded and why.

evaluation.description: Held-out tasks, metrics, baselines, and uncertainty estimates, with the evaluation code released.

failure_modes.description: Observed errors, subgroup gaps, distribution shifts, and conditions under which outputs should not be used.

geographic_validity.description: Cities trained and tested on, and evidence for or against transfer to other places.

task_workflow.title: Task & workflow
task_workflow.description: The research or planning task, the steps the agent performs, and where the workflow starts and stops.

data_provenance.title: Tools & data access
data_provenance.description: Models, datasets, APIs, and documents the agent can call or read, with their licences.

decision_boundaries.title: Decision boundaries
decision_boundaries.description: What the agent may decide alone, what requires a human, and how its outputs are reviewed.

evaluation.title: Evaluation protocol
evaluation.description: Success criteria, reliability across runs, comparison with human performance, and reproducibility.

failure_modes.description: Observed errors, fabrication risks, bias in retrieved evidence, and misuse scenarios.

traceability.title: Traceability
traceability.description: Logs, intermediate outputs, and citations the agent produces so that results can be audited.

usage_constraints.description: Intended users, settings where the agent must not be used, and cost or rate considerations.

urban_question.title: Research question
urban_question.description: The urban capability the task measures, and why that capability matters for a decision.

task_definition.title: Task definition
task_definition.description: Inputs, expected outputs, and the exact instructions or prompts given to a system under test.

data_provenance.title: Data
data_provenance.description: Source, geography, time span, licence, splits, and how test data is protected from leakage.

metrics.title: Metrics & criteria
metrics.description: Scoring rules, what counts as success, and how uncertainty or disagreement is reported.

baselines.title: Baselines
baselines.description: Reference systems, including simple and human baselines where they exist, with their scores.

evaluation.title: Task validation
evaluation.description: How the task itself was checked: annotation agreement, leakage tests, and whether scores track the capability it claims to measure.

failure_modes.title: Known limitations
failure_modes.description: Ways the benchmark can be gamed or misread, and capabilities it does not measure.

geographic_validity.title: Generalization protocol
geographic_validity.description: How performance is tested across cities, periods, or populations beyond the development data.

submission_rules.title: Submission rules
submission_rules.description: How results are submitted, what must be disclosed, and how evaluation code is run.

versioning_errata.title: Versioning & errata
versioning_errata.description: Version history, corrections to data or scoring, and how earlier results are handled.
